title: ALARMS VOLUME ROW AND A LIGHT TICK ON YOUR LAST ROUNDS
why: His 10-25 answers g-81 ("Yes, their own row") and g-82 ("Add a lighter click near empty"). Harsh sound is his worst party problem and the 5 minute alarm was still too loud, so AUDIO gets an ALARMS VOLUME row (OFF, 25%, 50%, 75%, FULL; FULL is today) that scales the machine alarm, the siege and extraction alarms, the lock-on siren, the raid clock, the crit and warn stings, the teammate down alert and the two and one minute cues. The clock moved off UI VOLUME so one row controls it (the UI VOLUME hint no longer says the clock). The last quarter of a magazine now gets a light tick just after the shot, about half the dry click, heard only in your own window. WATCH on the next play: at FULL nothing should sound different; at OFF the raid clock, siege and extraction alarms, lock-on siren and alert stings go quiet while guns, steps and good-news stings stay; UI VOLUME no longer moves the clock ticks; the low magazine tick must read under the gunshot without nagging (the Support MG ticks for its last 15, the Auto Rifle for its last 6).
now: Settings, AUDIO has an ALARMS VOLUME row for alarms, warnings and the raid clock, and your last quarter magazine ticks lightly under each shot.
